data.mechanism: TAX1BP1 acts as the adaptor that brings TBK1 onto stressed lysosomes, putting the kinase next to its substrate FNIP1.
data.mechanism_beginner: TAX1BP1 brings the kinase TBK1 to the lysosome.
data.context: Conditional on lysosomal stress, not on nutrients. This recruitment is reported under lysosomal stress signalled through the v-ATPase (VATPASE-TAX1BP1), and the route is explicitly nutrient-independent - so it is not expected to carry the amino-acid signal, and absence of amino-acid dependence is not evidence against it. Whether TBK1 or ULK1 is the kinase delivered is the open part: ESP2026 reports that either can be, and does not say what decides it in a given cell type or kind of stress (see TAX1BP1-ULK1 and question H11).
data.boundary: One study in human cell lines (ESP2026). Full text not accessible when this link was written; the adaptor role is taken from the authors' abstract.
